messages:
jess_cs: Heads-up — onboarding check-in with Nebula today 15:00 PT. Need quota plan + autoscale thresholds finalized. Current ask from sales: sustained 120k tokens/min, burst to 150k. Can ops/SE confirm feasibility? (cc @omar_se @liam_ops)
omar_se: I can run a smoke load test at 14:00 PT if we lock prompt mix. What's the expected avg seq len and embeddings ratio?
jess_cs: Prompt mix: ~70% chat gen (avg 130 tokens), 30% embedding requests (short payloads). I'll DM the sample prompts. Renewal check: customer flagged SLA risk if latency >200ms p95.
liam_ops: Quick capacity note — reserved pool currently 12xA10G -> rough sustained ~95k tokens/min with current batching. We need either +2 GPUs or tuning. Autoscale policy suggestion: scale-up when 70% token backlog or gpu_util>65% for 90s, scale-down after 5m idle. Thoughts?
tia_eng: FWIW on staging q4_0 quantized model with prefix KV caching and continuous batching hit 110k sustained on 12 GPUs. With prefix caching for top-50 prompts, burst to 150k looks feasible short-term.
omar_se: Nice. For the load test I'll use this k6 script and mimick 70/30 mix. Command:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m load-tests/nebulacorp-70-30.js
# env: MODEL=redwood-q4_0 SAMPLER=batching ENABLE_PREFIX_CACHE=true
```
I'll push results to the shared doc.
liam_ops: Can you include token/time-series output and GPU mem/util per-host? Ops runbook needs these in the artifact. Also please tag run with `#quota-priming` and add the list of warmup keys.
jess_cs: Will do. Also collecting enablement feedback items for renewal bundle: docs gaps, latency troubleshooting runbook, billing forecast for burst. Please add as comments on the doc.
traffic-bot: Scheduled load test: nebula-smoke-1738254321 at 2024-06-12T14:00:00Z (initiated by omar_se)
omar_se: Running checklist: 1) confirm sample prompts 2) run smoke 3) share artifacts 4) ops verify autoscale thresholds 5) CS capture feedback -> renewal notes :thumbsup:
liam_ops: OK locking autoscale thresholds to config: scale_up_threshold=0.7, scale_down_idle_mins=5. I'll stage a canary and monitor p95 latency. Ping me when results are in.
jess_cs: Great — final ask: please reply in-thread when artifacts uploaded. I'll summarise for AE and renewal lead. Thanks team! :pray:
